messages.subject: Re: ggplot2 web interface source code
parts:
Well... JS source for ggplot2 webapp is available within the HTML
file, it's only minified. I assume that you're looking for an
unminified one. Anyway, you still have to ask Jeroen, because of the
licensing issues. Even if you manage to get the source, the question
is what are you allowed to do with it. I'm not sure that I understand
the RApache configuration part, but you may find these links useful:
http://www.vcasmo.com/video/drewconway/7275
http://www.vcasmo.com/video/drewconway/7221

messages.subject: Re: ggplot2 web interface source code
parts:
Hello,

Thanks for the helpful links/advice.

I have also been trying to get the helloworld example that Jeroen puts
together in one of his YouTube clips.

I have installed the brew package.My httpd.conf has the following
entry:

LoadModule R_module modules/mod_R.so

ROutputErrors

<Location /RApacheInfo>
SetHandler r-info
</Location>

<Directory /var/www/brew>
SetHandler r-script
RHandler brew::brew
</Directory>

I can run R calculations however I cannot capture the POST data (i.e
myN <- as.numeric(POST$n)). Do I need something else configured for
this? I'm using R 2.11.1 & rapache-1.1.9.

Any help would be greatly appreciated.

Regards,

Fintan.
